purpose: Independent reference values for the satellite module: SGP4 states from Rhodes' sgp4, and look angles, passes, Sun altitude and Earth-shadow state from Skyfield with JPL DE421, for the frozen element sets. Both run the same SGP4 model as satellite.js, so this shows implementation agreement, not forecast accuracy against real sightings.

generated_by.timescale: Skyfield built-in (leap seconds and Delta T tables, no IERS earth-orientation download)
generated_by.shadow_model: Skyfield is_sunlit (Sun-centre ray against the Earth sphere)
